meta.name: renobattery-qa-checklist
meta.target: Theme must pass every automated check and at least 95% of manual checks before release.

automated_checks.cmd: for f in wp-theme/**/*.php; do php -l "$f"; done
python3 -c "import json,glob;[json.load(open(f)) for f in glob.glob('templates/elementor/*.json')]"
count unique msgids in renobattery.pot == zh_CN.po

elementor_compatibility.check: Every section/column/widget has an `id`, `elType`, and `settings` key
No section references an undefined `_ref` (flatten resolves all)
All widgets use widgetTypes that exist in Elementor core/Pro or Renobattery custom widgets
Dynamic tags use supported token syntax: {{post:*}}, {{acf:*}}, {{option:*}}, {{tax:*}}
Import each dist/*.json into a fresh WP install; zero import errors
Every page section editable in Elementor (no hardcoded markup)
Custom widgets appear under 'Renobattery' category in the widget panel
Theme Builder conditions set correctly for archive/single/header/footer
Responsive tablet/mobile overrides render correctly in Elementor preview

checks_per_viewport: Navbar: logo + burger fit, no overflow
Filter pills: wrap, don't horizontally scroll
Mobile drawer opens full-screen and scroll-locks body

image_checks: Hero image served as AVIF or WebP
All below-fold images have loading='lazy' decoding='async'
All have width + height or aspect-ratio container (no CLS)

manual: Tab-only navigation reaches every interactive element in DOM order
Focus rings visible on all focusable elements (:focus-visible)
Mega-menu opens on Enter/Space, closes on Escape
Mobile drawer traps focus while open (known scope — recommend adding focus trap later)
All images have meaningful or empty alt
Color contrast ≥ 4.5:1 for body text, ≥ 3:1 for large text
Forms: every input has a <label>, errors announced via aria-live
Reduced motion: enabling OS setting disables all non-essential animation

head_meta: Open Graph: og:title, og:description, og:image, og:url, og:type, og:locale
hreflang emitted for EN + ZH + x-default on every translated URL
schema_org: Organization on home (Google Rich Results test passes)
Product on every single product with at least 3 additionalProperty entries
sitemap: XML sitemap accessible at /sitemap_index.xml (via Rank Math/Yoast)
Sitemap includes all 3 CPTs, all taxonomies, pages, posts
bilingual URLs include xhtml:link alternate entries

content_coverage.check: Every URL returns 200 and renders the expected template. No dead internal links (crawl with linkcheck).

bilingual_parity: Every EN URL has a ZH counterpart reachable via the language switcher
Polylang → Languages → Strings: every registered string has a zh_CN translation
All ACF fields marked translate have distinct ZH values; marked copy share values across languages
hreflang present on every translated URL
<html lang> reflects current language; font stack switches to PingFang SC
security: All user input sanitized: sanitize_text_field, esc_attr, esc_url
All form output escaped: esc_html, wp_kses_post, esc_url, wp_json_encode
Forms use WP nonces (Elementor Forms handles this)
No direct DB queries in theme code (only WP API)
File uploads limited to expected media types
No hardcoded API keys in repo
elementor_import_export: Activate theme on fresh WP install with Elementor Pro + ACF Pro
Import each dist/*.json via Templates → Saved Templates → Import
Assign Theme Builder conditions per docs/step-01-architecture.json matrix
Visit /products/ and confirm Loop Grid uses product-card template
Create 3 sample products with ACF fields populated
Confirm hero video bg, gallery carousel, spec table all render

launch_runbook.action: Upload theme zip to /wp-content/themes/renobattery/ and activate
Install + activate: Elementor Pro, ACF Pro, Polylang, Rank Math, WP Rocket
Polylang: register en + zh, URL mode = directory, scan translate strings
ACF Options → Site Options: fill phone/email/address/social/CTA
Upload sample content: 6 products, 4 cases, 5 applications, 6 blog posts
Flush permalinks; test every URL in content_coverage table
Run Lighthouse on home + product single (mobile + desktop)

known_limitations: filter.js relies on a pre_get_posts hook on the product archive accepting ?product_cat=slug — not yet shipped; add before launch if ajax filter needed on post-type archive
Mobile drawer lacks keyboard focus trap — add inert polyfill or focus-trap library
Loop Grid 'product-card' template id must be manually set in dist templates after first import (documented in templates/elementor/README.md)
